recent_excerpts: ETS breach exposed names, addresses, disability status and test results for all California public school students since 2023 — 5.7 million enrolled in 2025 alone.
FBI arrested CyberSteward co-founder Edward Dubrovsky on cyber extortion charges tied to ShinyHunters, the group that stole data on thousands of FBI agents.
iRhythm says a June social engineering attack exposed names, insurance numbers, and device serials for 360,000 patients across Texas, South Carolina, and California.
